name: ctx-agent-history-search
tagline_zh: 新任务卡壳？先翻旧账。检索本地编码代理的历史会话，找出之前的决策、尝试和坑，别让AI重复踩雷。
tagline_en: Stuck? Search past agent sessions for decisions, attempts, and pitfalls—don't let AI repeat old mistakes.
desc_en: Use ctx to search local coding-agent history before acting. Use when prior agent sessions may contain relevant insights, decisions, attempts, or transcript context.
why_zh: 同类工具只搜代码，它搜的是代理的完整思考轨迹，连失败尝试都保留，让你站在历史肩膀上。
why_en: Unlike code search, it indexes full agent reasoning trails, including failed attempts—so you build on past context, not repeat it.
